justification: The evidence strongly supports operational robustness across the specified deployment context. The system maintains high performance (above 90% accuracy) under various realistic operational stressors, including formatting variations, missing non-critical fields, OCR degradation, and predefined perturbation tests. Additionally, the system possesses an effective out-of-distribution (OOD) detection mechanism, flagging 1,127 out of 1,200 OOD documents, and these results were independently reproduced by a separate validation team.
evidence_used: With 10% randomly removed non-critical fields, accuracy was 93.7%.
With the predefined OCR degradation transformation, accuracy was 92.1%.
Across the predefined formatting-variation set, accuracy ranged from 91.6% to 94.8%.
An out-of-distribution test set contained 1,200 documents from document classes excluded from training.
Of the 1,200 out-of-distribution samples, 1,127 were flagged by the out-of-distribution mechanism.
The validation protocol contains three predefined perturbation tests; corresponding accuracies were 92.8%, 90.9%, and 93.4%.
A separate validation team reproduced the reported tests.
limitations: The performance or impact of the 73 unflagged out-of-distribution documents (which bypassed the OOD mechanism) is not specified.
It is unclear if the predefined perturbation and formatting-variation sets comprehensively cover all real-world variations encountered in the actual deployment environment.
